svg.title: Tax analytics wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / TAX ANALYTICS
Composition and rates from completed results.
Stacked bars use the same tax result as the Brackets view.
Four metrics: legacy $25.8M, average effective tax rate 30.29%, withdrawal rate 1.69%, and lifetime taxes.
Income and Rates are views of one tax result, not separate calculations.
Selecting a year changes the composition detail. Values stay in sync with the chart.
Customize metrics persists per user and reorders or hides cards without changing the underlying result.
